text:
ash: Heads-up — since 06:40 UTC we're seeing a burst of etcd leader switches in eu-west1 followed by apiserver 5xx spikes and a pile-up of GPU attach requests. Pods stuck in ContainerCreating for tens of seconds.
priya: I can see the same on dashboards. apiserver lat p50 -> 450ms, p95 -> 2.1s, a bunch of 503s. GPU attach queue length climbed from ~3 to ~120 in 10m.
joel: Any network events? MTU mismatch or peering flaps recently?
maria: Net infra pushed a route change at ~06:35, but they said it was low-impact. I'll double-check.
ash: posting a short grep from apiserver logs: 
```
E0604 06:41:12.123456 1 cacher.go:312] watch chan failed (watch closed)
E0604 06:41:12.223987 1 handler.go:108] apiserver error: 503 Service Unavailable
E0604 06:41:13.129012 1 etcd.go:87] etcd: leader changed: old=10.0.5.12 new=10.0.7.3
```
priya: That lines up with leader flips. When leader changes we get KV cache storm and controllers requeue. Controller-manager resyncs amplify attach requests.
joel: Can we confirm NAT port exhaustion? SNAT exhaustion would cause controlplane->etcd timeouts and pod attach RPCs to fail. `kubectl get pods -n kube-system` shows `apiserver` restarts?
ash: apiserver pods are stable (no restarts), but kube-proxy logs show a lot of conntrack rejects. snippet: `conntrack: table full, dropping packet`
maria: Looks like egress NAT buckets in eu-west1 are saturated — dozens of nodes sharing a small pool. That matches the SNAT theory.
priya: Immediate mitigations we can do now: 1) increase apiserver replicas from 3 -> 5 in eu-west1 controlplane ASG (reduces per-instance load). 2) bump conntrack table sizes and net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max on nodes. 3) add short-term dedicated NATers (extra nodes with larger SNAT pools). Thoughts?
joel: Agree on conntrack bump and add nat nodes. But beware: increasing apiserver replicas without addressing etcd leader churn won't help long-term. We should reduce load on etcd: throttle controller backoff for attach controller and pause non-critical rollouts.
sam: On the GPU side we can temporarily route new attach requests to non-eu clusters for lower latency if policy allows. Might help onboarding pressure.
priya: I'll open a rollback gate and set a synthetic canary to suspend non-urgent GPU provisioning for 15m. @maria can you spin up 2 nat-eu-large nodes and add to nat pool?
maria: On it. ETA ~8m. Also increasing conntrack now on the node pool: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` and persist via cloud-init.
nash: Controller-manager tuning suggestion: bump `--workqueue-max-requests` for attach controller down, increase `--controller-sync-period` for non-critical controllers. I'll propose values in the runbook.
priya: Good. Also let's add an etcd prober to detect leader oscillation and auto-scale an extra etcd voting node (read-only follower) if leader changes > 3 within 5m. Needs careful thought (quorum impact).
joel: Long term: provision dedicated etcd instances on isolated hosts (disks+network), and review MTU across peering links — some interfaces reported 1500 vs 9000 and fragmentation is causing TCP retransmits during leader elections.
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1423, severity=P2, assignees=[priya, maria], summary="eu-west1 etcd leader oscillation -> apiserver 5xx -> GPU attach queue"
priya: I'll coordinate with network and infra. Will update after NAT nodes are up and conntrack bumped. If things don't improve in 15m we escalate to oncall infra.
nash: Thanks team — postmortem candidate. We should also add a cost note: spinning dedicated nat nodes + conntrack defaults will add ~0.5% to monthly infra spend for eu-west1 but saves expensive GPU job failures. Worth it. :thumbsup:
joel: Filing follow-ups: 1) permanent increase to node SNAT capacity 2) rollout tuned controller-manager flags 3) etcd isolation plan 4) network MTU audit.
priya: Update 06:52 UTC: nat-eu-large nodes are attached; conntrack applied to node pool. apiserver p95 down to 380ms, attach queue falling -> 24. continuing to monitor.
maria: Logs show leader stable for last 9 mins. closing immediate loop. will keep watch.
priya: closing this thread once we confirm 30m of stability. Thanks everyone.
